set.body: sbt's ForkMain handshake hangs intermittently on this machine: the forked test JVM sits in ObjectInputStream.readStreamHeader while sbt's Acceptor waits. It stalled CR6a, CR6b, UI-G G3 and the Codex batch audit on 2026-09-26/27, costing hours. The Codex team reproduced the mechanism (an sbt wildcard listener colliding with an IPv4-specific listener; /private/tmp/eyes4s-owned-bind.*/result.md) and verified that -Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=true avoids it. Today each builder sets JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS by hand. Fix: add the flag to the repo's .jvmopts (sbt's own JVM) and, if needed, to forked test javaOptions in build.sbt; confirm CI (Temurin 17/21/25, Linux/macOS) is unaffected; add a gate script under tools/ that captures the landing-policy order (audit first). Acceptance: 5 consecutive full local gates without a handshake stall.
set.title: Make the IPv6 fork-handshake workaround the default for local gates
